answer_1.quote: We investigate how state-of-the-art neural language models can learn and generalize out of SOCIAL-CHEM-101 to accurately reason about social norms with respect to a previously unseen situation. We term this modeling framework NEURAL NORM TRANSFORMER, and find it is able to generate relevant (and potentially novel) rules-of-thumb conditioned on all attribute dimensions.

answer_2.quote: We also provide automatic metrics of the generated outputs. We train attributes classifiers using RoBERTa, and use them to classify the model outputs.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Table presents a human evaluation measuring how effective models are at generating RoTs and actions for both task settings.
answer_4.guideline: While most columns measure attribute adherence, the Relevance score is critical for distinguishing whether RoTs actually apply to the provided situation.
